speakers.description: An off-screen narrator, heard but not seen.

claims.text: The first shot shows an empty railway station platform.
The second shot shows a train departing.
A continuous off-screen voice speaks the supplied line across both shots, starting in the first shot and finishing in the second.
Only the supplied sign text appears in the first shot.
There is no other dialogue and no music.

constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

description.text: An empty railway station platform beside still tracks. A hanging sign is the only visible lettering in the scene. The platform is unoccupied and motionless as an off-screen narrator's voice begins and carries a continuous line toward the cut.
An empty railway station platform beside still tracks, with no travelers in view and a hanging sign overhead.

A train pulls away from the empty platform and recedes along the track. The platform is left behind in stillness. The off-screen narrator's voice finishes the same continuous line as the train moves into the distance.
The train pulls away from the platform and recedes along the track.
The rhythmic clatter of train wheels rolls away and fades into the distance.

soundscape: Low station ambience and the rhythmic clatter of train wheels rolling away into the distance.
